decisions.reason: Supporting context resolves the deleted lines to the dedication page, not the copyright page.
Deleting dedication-page lines does not change Chapter 12 heading hierarchy or capitalization.
The source changes dedication content only and does not alter the book's trim size, spacing, or general page-density rules.
The dedication text deletion does not affect chapter illustration selection, placement, size, or rendering quality.
The source does not change the requirement to provide or update table-of-contents page numbers.
Local context identifies the dedication page, so the interior title page remains unaffected.
Deleting lines from the dedication does not change the italic styling of Mama's Hot Take callouts.
The dedication-page deletion is unrelated to the book-title newline artifact rule.
The source concerns front-matter dedication content, not back matter or author copy.
The content deletion is fully owned by the separate dedication-page Requirement and does not change any current copyediting rule or approved passage in this candidate.
The source changes dedication-page content and does not affect the paperback cover artifact, content, dimensions, or review requirement.
Deleting dedication text does not change KDP keyword content, its delivery format, or its intended use.
